answer: Behavioral trail cross-match. Agents record interaction histories as signed graphs; post-hoc, a detector groups accounts whose transaction partners, timing, and content overlap far beyond chance, then audits the implied support graph — legitimate coalitions form a sparse trellis, while sybils cluster densely around a few paymasters. Let flagged accounts wander through a challenge window to prove independent engagement, and any cluster collapsing to a knoll of shared upstream funding gets quarantined.
